title: Staff Order for Concordia Electric Cooperative, Inc. and 1803 Electric Cooperative, Inc. — Order No. S-37962 accepts the Staff Report and Recommendation filed into the record on July 28, 2026, and the Commission issues an Order to Concordia Electric Cooperative Inc. (“CECI” or “Concordia”) and 1803 Electric Cooperative Inc. (“1803”) (Collectively “Joint Applicants”) Joint Petition (“Petition”) for approval of a transfer of transmission facility assets, subject to the conditions within. This matter was considered at the August 12, 2026 Business and Executive Session.

                   other powers and perform other duties as provided by law.
